svg.aria-label: Gautam Khosla. Ascend higher, with a lightning bolt and a roller coaster.
svg.title: Gautam Khosla. Ascend higher, with a lightning bolt and a roller coaster.
svg.desc: A split-flap departure board flips to spell Gautam Khosla. The second line reads "Ascend higher" and ends with two pictogram flaps: an amber lightning bolt, and a roller coaster climbing a lift hill toward a loop. Now boarding: Counterseal, live. CRA Clock, live. Holdout, in beta.
